segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בַּיִת שֶׁהוּא מָלֵא פֵּירוֹת וְנִפְחַת — נוֹטֵל מִמְּקוֹם הַפְּחָת. רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹמֵר: אַף פּוֹחֵת לְכַתְּחִלָּה וְנוֹטֵל.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If there is «a house that is filled with produce» and locked on all sides, «and a hole formed» in one of its walls or its roof, «one may remove» produce «through the place of the hole.» The produce is not considered muktze, even though one cannot reach it without the existence of the hole. «Rabbi Meir says: One may even make a hole ab initio and take» produce through that opening.
